action_items: Consider hardening backend _update_env_file to treat empty/whitespace GEMINI_API_KEY/RESEND_API_KEY as 'keep existing' rather than overwriting, as a server-side safety net (frontend already filters, but defense-in-depth prevents API mis-use from wiping keys).
Optional: verify gen_ms is populated on send logs created AFTER generate+send (trigger one fresh send to confirm).
